scope: Accepted class-ability use invokes shared Slow and grants combatant resistance; actual successful enemy Slow from any producer grants three seconds of additional base regeneration to the currently selected class account.

implementation.core_changes: No new engine primitives or storage shapes. Uses accepted ability facts, typed bundle invocation, successful status facts, resource selection, base_percent and existing status/world adapters.

acceptance: A paid Marksman cast produces one pulse even with duplicate Aspect sources. Actual target classification selects 60 combatant or 40 Guardian Slow stacks; activity mode selects the 9/8 meter range.
Stasis Guardian timing is 1.5 seconds plus a Durance-specific .5. Combatant duration and extension are required calibration inputs. Prismatic uses 8/1.5 seconds with no Durance extension.
Denied or missing Slow does not grant regeneration. An accepted class use still grants resistance. Rejected abilities and non-class abilities carrying forged input tags do not trigger the Aspect.
Every successful enemy Slow application can qualify. Credit uses the actual applying actor even when shared Slow retains its first applier. Allies and unknown relations do not qualify.

The rate is stat-adjusted baseline plus baseline times 3 in PvE or 1.5 in PvP, for three seconds. Selection changes redirect the bonus; retained accounts keep only their existing baseline policy. Repeated successes refresh the duration and duplicate status identities do not.
Shared Slow converts at 100 stacks through the existing authorized Freeze application. Ascension composes the same Slow, Jolt and Amplified and pays the selected dodge only once.

The 50 percent combatant-only resistance changes real health loss and excludes unclassified and Guardian-tagged attacks. Granted benefits have independent deadlines, persist after source removal, and are removed on death.
Unknown authorization retains prior state and payment and stops without replay. Pure session restoration preserves timers, receipt retention and regeneration integration.
policies: Class usage means a trusted accepted resolved ability with chorus:class_ability, including Ascension. The rule is not restricted to the class input slot. Formal legal subclass/Aspect selection remains separate.

The pulse observes living caster and targets at the accepted-start reaction. Its inclusive feet-position sphere has no additional line-of-sight requirement. The precise original-game animation frame, range anchors and obstruction rules remain unverified.
Resistance is granted before the target query; the duration must be explicitly calibrated because both source sheets say 4? seconds. Tests use 4 seconds, not a measured claim.

Successful status_id and accepted cast identities are shared across Aspect copies for a finite 60-second retention window. Timed forgetting bounds retained identities; this does not suppress legal independent effect chains.

Regeneration refreshes to three seconds; combatant resistance refreshes to its calibrated duration. Already granted buffs persist when the Aspect is removed, while future status facts no longer trigger it. These lifecycle choices require original-game validation.

The shared class profile separates baseline replacement, stat multiplication and additional_base. Gambler baseline modifiers are restricted to the Gambler resource ID so they cannot override retained Marksman accounts.

Marksman keeps its existing independent 1/42 baseline after deselection. Gambler obtains 1/56 only while selected and pauses after clearing. A unified class resource pool and original-game swap penalties are not introduced by this change.
gaps: Stasis combatant Slow 8+4? and resistance 4? seconds are explicitly uncertain in the source. Test 8+4 and 4 seconds remain synthetic. Complete Class-stat recovery curves and gameplay scaling are not calibrated.

Slow jump delta, Freeze/Shatter threshold, radius and Guardian damage are inherited explicit test inputs; original-game spatial timing, refresh/credit, source-detach and death-order edge cases need calibration.

The Aspect is a trusted-host source, with separate Stasis and Prismatic templates. Production subclass/Aspect slots, three-fragment capacity, unlocks and legal loadout constraints are not yet assembled.

All other producer, exotic and fragment combinations, formal effects assets/HUD, physical world persistence and the NeoForge graphical client remain incomplete. Definitions currently live in test resources.
